main: ^Wow, you are the most beautiful fish! How do you stay so shiny?
^Hey, I am not just any fish...I am GOLD fish. And it’s all natural, honey.
^You seem almost…magical. Am I staring?! Sorry! My name is Bobby!
^That’s okay, Bobby. You are right, I am magical.
^I have the power to grant you one wish of your choosing. What will it be?
^Anything I want?! A big, BIG house filled with tuna and chicken and toys and…
^Slow down, sweetie. I can’t do all that! But I could change the world around you?
^Hmm. I want to get my groove on. Can you change the music in the ocean?
^That I can do! You have two choices of music artists before you...
^Will you choose the artist Pablo...or will you choose the artist Mariia?

c-0: ^An excellent choice but, of course, they are both excellent choices. Enjoy your groove Bobby!
